title: DepEd Caraga draws flak for using Manobo ‘suyam’ design

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO. Agusan del Sur— The Department of Education (DepEd) in the Caraga Region has suspended the printing, distribution, and wearing of regional branding T-shirts featuring the traditional Manobo suyam embroidery after it drew flak from the Indigenous community for apparent cultural misappropriation. In an official statement, DepEd Caraga apologized for the oversight and acknowledged that the suyam—a sacred, intricate hand-embroidery tradition practiced primarily by Agusanon Manobo cultural bearers in Agusan del Sur—is not merely an artistic or decorative pattern. Instead, the agency noted, it is a vital expression of the Manobo people’s cultural identity, heritage, and collective intellectual property. READ: Educators changing lives […]...
